title: OTA Fleet
description: Live fleet health, the current rollout and every orchestrator decision.

list.name: rollout
list.label: Rollout
list.query: SELECT __value, __text FROM (SELECT 0 AS __value, 'latest' AS __text UNION ALL SELECT id, '#' || id || '  ' || target_version || '  ' || state FROM rollouts) v ORDER BY (__value = 0) DESC, __value DESC

panels.title: Devices
panels.description: Every device in the registry.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS devices FROM devices
SELECT count(*) FROM devices WHERE status = 'healthy'

panels.title: Unhealthy
panels.description: Devices whose latest heartbeat reported unhealthy or degraded firmware.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM devices WHERE status IN ('unhealthy', 'degraded')

panels.title: Offline
panels.description: No heartbeat within the heartbeat timeout (30 s by default).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM devices WHERE status IN ('offline', 'unknown')

panels.title: Fleet
panels.description: Each device's latest heartbeat: errors and crashes since the previous one.

targets.rawSql: SELECT device_id AS "Device", current_version AS "Version", status AS "Status", error_count AS "Errors", crash_count AS "Crashes", round(cpu_percent::numeric, 1) AS "CPU %", round(memory_mb::numeric, 1) AS "Memory (MiB)", seconds_since_heartbeat AS "Last seen (s)" FROM fleet_overview ORDER BY device_id
SELECT coalesce(current_version, 'unknown') AS "Version", count(*) AS "Devices" FROM devices GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Firmware errors
panels.description: Errors reported in heartbeats, per device.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(received_at, '15s'), device_id AS metric, sum(error_count) AS value FROM heartbeats WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Firmware crashes
panels.description: Firmware crashes reported in heartbeats, per device.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(received_at, '15s'), device_id AS metric, sum(crash_count) AS value FROM heartbeats WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Devices reporting
panels.description: Distinct devices that sent a heartbeat: drops show devices going offline.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(received_at, '15s'), count(DISTINCT device_id) AS "Devices reporting" FROM heartbeats WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT '#' || r.id AS "Rollout", upper(r.state) AS "State", r.target_version AS "Target", r.rollback_version AS "Rollback to", CASE WHEN r.stage_count > 1 THEN r.current_stage || ' of ' || r.stage_count ELSE 'single' END AS "Stage", round(100.0 * count(rd.device_id) FILTER ( WHERE rd.state IN ('commanded', 'updated', 'failed', 'rolled_back') AND rd.verdict IS DISTINCT FROM 'not_reached') / NULLIF((SELECT count(*) FROM devices d WHERE d.registered_at <= COALESCE(r.started_at, now())), 0)) AS "Fleet exposed (%)", count(rd.device_id) FILTER (WHERE rd.verdict = 'healthy') AS "Passed health window", count(rd.device_id) FILTER (WHERE rd.verdict IN ('unhealthy', 'unresponsive', 'failed_update', 'no_reply')) AS "Failed" FROM rollouts r LEFT JOIN rollout_devices rd ON rd.rollout_id = r.id WHERE r.id = (CASE WHEN $rollout = 0 THEN (SELECT max(id) FROM rollouts) ELSE $rollout END) GROUP BY r.id

panels.title: Devices in this rollout
panels.description: Each device's stage, progress and health verdict. 'watching': in its health window; 'waiting for its stage': its stage has not started yet.

targets.rawSql: SELECT rd.stage AS "Stage", rd.device_id AS "Device", rd.state AS "Rollout state", coalesce(rd.verdict, CASE WHEN rd.state = 'updated' THEN 'watching' WHEN rd.state = 'pending' THEN 'waiting for its stage' END) AS "Health", rd.verdict_reason AS "Why", d.current_version AS "Reports" FROM rollout_devices rd JOIN devices d ON d.device_id = rd.device_id WHERE rd.rollout_id = (CASE WHEN $rollout = 0 THEN (SELECT max(id) FROM rollouts) ELSE $rollout END) ORDER BY rd.stage, rd.device_id

panels.title: Decision log
panels.description: Every orchestrator decision for this rollout, with its reason (NF-5).

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS "Time", event AS "Decision", reason AS "Reason" FROM rollout_events WHERE rollout_id = (CASE WHEN $rollout = 0 THEN (SELECT max(id) FROM rollouts) ELSE $rollout END) ORDER BY id DESC

panels.title: Rollout history
panels.description: Recent rollouts with their timings: the source for time to detect and time to roll back.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.id AS "Rollout", r.target_version AS "Target", r.rollback_version AS "Rollback to", r.state AS "State", coalesce(r.stage_plan, 'single') AS "Stages", r.started_at AS "Started", round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (coalesce(r.ended_at, now()) - r.started_at))) AS "Duration (s)", round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (min(e.created_at) FILTER (WHERE e.event = 'halted') - r.started_at))) AS "Time to halt (s)", round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (min(e.created_at) FILTER (WHERE e.event = 'rollback_completed') - min(e.created_at) FILTER (WHERE e.event = 'halted')))) AS "Time to roll back (s)", r.halt_reason AS "Halt reason" FROM rollouts r LEFT JOIN rollout_events e ON e.rollout_id = r.id GROUP BY r.id ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Fleet memory
panels.description: Memory of all online device containers (agent and firmware), from their heartbeats.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(memory_mb) FROM devices WHERE status NOT IN ('offline', 'unknown')

panels.title: Fleet CPU
panels.description: CPU of all online device containers, in percent of one core.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(cpu_percent) FROM devices WHERE status NOT IN ('offline', 'unknown')

panels.title: Memory per device
panels.description: Average memory of an online device container.

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(memory_mb) FROM devices WHERE status NOT IN ('offline', 'unknown')

panels.title: Control plane memory
panels.description: Memory of all control-plane containers, sampled every 5 s by the stats collector.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(memory_mb) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (service) service, cpu_percent, memory_mb FROM control_plane_stats WHERE sampled_at > now() - interval '1 minute' ORDER BY service, sampled_at DESC) s

panels.title: Control plane now
panels.description: Each control-plane container's latest CPU and memory.

targets.rawSql: SELECT service AS "Service", round(cpu_percent::numeric, 1) AS "CPU %", round(memory_mb::numeric, 1) AS "Memory (MiB)" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (service) service, cpu_percent, memory_mb FROM control_plane_stats WHERE sampled_at > now() - interval '1 minute' ORDER BY service, sampled_at DESC) s ORDER BY service

panels.title: Device memory
panels.description: Each device container's memory, from its heartbeats.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(received_at, '15s'), device_id AS metric, avg(memory_mb) AS value FROM heartbeats WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND memory_mb IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Device CPU
panels.description: Each device container's CPU, in percent of one core.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(received_at, '15s'), device_id AS metric, avg(cpu_percent) AS value FROM heartbeats WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND cpu_percent IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(sampled_at, '15s'), service AS metric, avg(memory_mb) AS value FROM control_plane_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(sampled_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(sampled_at, '15s'), service AS metric, avg(cpu_percent) AS value FROM control_plane_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(sampled_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Rejected messages
panels.description: Malformed or invalid messages the orchestrator refused (in the selected time range).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM rejected_messages WHERE kind = 'invalid_message' AND $__timeFilter(received_at)

panels.title: Refused commands
panels.description: Forged or replayed commands that devices refused to install (in the selected time range).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM rejected_messages WHERE kind = 'refused_command' AND $__timeFilter(received_at)

panels.title: Rejected and refused
panels.description: invalid_message: the orchestrator refused a malformed message. refused_command: a device refused a command the orchestrator never sent (forged or replayed).

targets.rawSql: SELECT received_at AS "Time", device_id AS "Device", kind AS "Kind", reason AS "Reason", payload AS "Message" FROM rejected_messages WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100
